subject: Action required: complete your online assessment
body:
Hi Sam,

Congratulations on progressing to the next stage of the KPMG Consulting Graduate process.

Please complete your numerical and verbal reasoning assessment by 11:59pm AEDT on Sunday 11 October. The assessment takes about 40 minutes and cannot be paused.

Begin: https://kpmg.assessments.com/start/4471
